How long will it take to recover?

Right, let me look at it. Lift the arm. Good. Now out to the side. Does that hurt? Okay. So the good news is that nothing is torn, and you should be back in the water in about ten days. The bad news is that this did not start on Saturday. Your shoulder has been overloaded for months, because you paddle every morning and you never warm up. Nobody your age warms up, and every single one of you ends up in this room. So: no paddling for a week, ice twice a day, and when you come back you should stretch for five minutes before you go out. Every time. That is not advice, that is the condition.

Mate, I did exactly the same thing two years ago and I will tell you what I got wrong. I went back too early. It felt fine after four days, so I paddled out, and then I lost the whole winter instead of one week. If it still hurts, you should not go in, and I know that is not what you want to hear. The other thing nobody tells you: you might get a bit down while you are out of the water. That is normal. Go to the beach anyway, watch, talk to people. The ones who disappear for three weeks are the ones who come back slowest.
